verdict.rationale: Swell's backend API uses secret keys over basic auth, and keys are environment-specific: sk_test_ keys reach only the test environment while sk_live_ keys reach live data. That lets you give an agent test-only credentials, a coarse form of scoping. Role-based permissions are documented only for human team members, not for API keys. missing for 10: per-key permission scopes (e.g. read-only or per-model access), evidence of issuing multiple restricted keys for agents, key rotation/revocation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
